title: Should AI Tutors Replace Traditional Teaching?
background: AI tutors can personalize instruction and expand access, while classroom learning also involves social development, mentorship, motivation, privacy and uneven technology access.
background_brief: AI tutors can personalize instruction and expand access, while classroom learning also involves social development, mentorship, motivation, privacy and uneven technology access.
opening_prompt: Suppose every student could access a personalized AI tutor at almost zero cost. Should education systems shift towards AI-driven learning, or would this sacrifice important aspects of human teaching? Discuss who benefits, who might be disadvantaged, and what an ideal education system would look like.
